column1: # current fact -> provenance/index pointer -> historical evidence on demand. Every evidence artifact of this repository
# (research bundles, release records, governance audits, evaluation runs, the committed state) is one row here or one
# member of a family row, with its retention class, whether it is operative now, what it concerned, what it supported,
# who loads or cites it today, and why it is kept. tests/test-evidence-index.sh holds the index to the tree and the
# readers column to the tree's actual references; a shipped surface that reads a non-operative artifact is a leak
# unless this index lists it as a reader.
# Classes (closed): active-current (required to establish current state or a contract) | historical-retained (audit,
# release or provenance value; not operative) | redundant (duplicate with no independent retention value) |
# do-not-delete (retention required or uncertain). Nothing was moved or deleted by #742: physical organization and
# hot-path reduction are reported separately in docs/research/v0.23-cleanup/742-evidence-separation.md.
# Columns: family (;-separated paths or globs) <TAB> class <TAB> operative-now <TAB> files <TAB> bytes <TAB> lines <TAB>
# concerns (release / HEAD / work unit) <TAB> fact supported <TAB> readers (;-separated paths, or -) <TAB> rationale
